seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Cincinnati Bengals at Pittsburgh Steelers at Pittsburgh Steelers +1.2 with a 45.7 fair total. Cincinnati Bengals wins 55% of simulations. Model status AGREEMENT. Research, not picks.

research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 17 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play), while Pittsburgh Steelers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#18 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Pittsburgh Steelers +1.2 with a fair total of 45.7 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Pittsburgh Steelers pass defence, which sits +0.041 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
